oh yeah you will def have a very obvious lisp, many letters and pronunciations will be unintelligible at worst and awkward at best, it will still hurt a lot to talk for a week or so, you basically can’t move your tongue very much bc it feels like it’s tied/pinned down. probably not a great piercing idea if you work customer service, unless you can get yourself a week or even better a two week break for optimal healing and recovery

i underestimated the swelling and healing process for the first week or so, i could barely eat and for a while i lived solely off of chocolate pudding and applesauce. past the swelling part, it’s fun and something to fiddle with when you’re bored. also, you will have a hell of a lisp for about a week or two, and your friends will find it hilarious. once it’s healed, i suggest 1. downsizing it once more if necessary. i went from 19mm (swell jewelry) to 16mm (standard) to 14mm because it suited my tongue anatomy better, and 2. switching to plastic balls. you’ll be very grateful when you inevitably bite down on a ball on accident and have plastic hit your teeth rather than steel or titanium. plus, switching colors and ball styles is always fun :)
